02 / THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE PURPOSE

Built by people.
Driven by a shared motive.

Silicon Motives was founded by Jayasoorya S and Jasil M in Kochi, Kerala, with a simple idea: build an efficient engineering company where location doesn’t determine quality.

We’re shaping a team that values ownership, honest conversations, and pride in the product. A company where clients pay for engineering value, and where good people have the space to do meaningful work.

09 / FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Before we
get started.

How does working with a remote team work?+

We agree on communication channels, review points, and a working rhythm at the beginning. Written updates, shared documentation, and scheduled conversations help keep decisions and progress clear.

Can you help with an existing product?+

Yes. We can start by understanding the existing software, its constraints, and your priorities, then agree on a focused plan for fixes, improvements, or new features.

How do you estimate cost and timelines?+

We first need to understand your requirements and the current state of the project. From there, we can define the scope, discuss tradeoffs, and agree on an estimate before work begins.

Where is Silicon Motives based?+

We are based in Kochi, Kerala, India, and work remotely. Our working arrangements and meeting times can be discussed around the needs of each project.

What should I have ready for a first conversation?+

A short description of your idea or challenge is a great start. If you have a timeline, budget range, or existing product, those details help us understand what a useful next step looks like.
